page_title: VAL 2-1 VLL | Valencia v Valladolid 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Raul Moro (Valladolid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valladolid comes to nothing.
90+2' Here's the change. Enzo Barrenechea leaves the pitch and Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) comes on as a substitute.
90+1' Raul Moro (Valladolid) serves up a nice cross, but Giorgi Mamardashvili punches the ball away.
90+1' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Juan Pulido saw the whole situation. Valladolid are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.

90' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) outjumps his marker from the resulting set piece and produces a powerful header that crashes against the bar. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
89' Valencia force a corner. They send men into the box.
86' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) receives a yellow card from the referee for dissent.

86' The game is interrupted. Luis Perez (Valladolid) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Free kick. Valencia will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
84' A yellow card for a tackle by Jose Gaya (Valencia). Juan Pulido doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
81' Substitution. Luis Rioja did his best and is replaced by Sergi Canos (Valencia).
80' Raul Moro (Valladolid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts the ball.

80' Pepelu (Valencia) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
79' It looks like Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) saw red with that tackle. Juan Pulido won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Valencia have been awarded a free kick.
76' Rough tackle by Cesar Tarrega (Valencia). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Valladolid win a free kick.
76' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
74' Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Juan Pulido blows for a foul. Valencia will take a free kick near the side line.
74' A substitution has been made. Andre Almeida is replaced by Ivan Jaime (Valencia).
71' Substitution. Ivan Sanchez makes way for Darwin Machis (Valladolid).
71' Here is a change. Adam Aznou is going off and Alvaro Rubio gives the last tactical orders to Anuar (Valladolid).
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Fran Perez (Valencia) for Diego Lopez.
70' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Javi Guerra and he is replaced by Pepelu (Valencia).
70' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Juanmi Latasa.
69' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. A free kick to Valladolid.
66' The foul by Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Juan Pulido.
66' A pass into the penalty area from Luis Rioja (Valencia) is intercepted by the defence.
65' Substitution. Marcos Andre is replaced by Selim Amallah (Valladolid).
65' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.

64' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Giorgi Mamardashvili, who pulls off a stunning save!
63' Luis Rioja (Valencia) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
61' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
61' Valladolid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

61' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Giorgi Mamardashvili, who pulls off a stunning save! Good work from Valladolid as they win a corner.
60' Raul Moro (Valladolid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
58' 2 - 1 Umar Sadiq (Valencia) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom left corner.
55' Substitution. Chuki (Valladolid) has come on for Florian Grillitsch.
55' Florian Grillitsch (Valladolid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Diego Lopez (Valencia) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
52' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Valencia.
51' Juan Pulido couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Javi Guerra (Valencia) and blew his whistle. Valladolid are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
51' The referee blows his whistle as Marcos Andre (Valladolid) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Valencia in a dangerous position.
49' Jose Gaya (Valencia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
48' The attendance is 41720.
47' Jose Gaya (Valencia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul. Valladolid have a free kick.
46' Half-chance! Raul Moro (Valladolid) plays a pass into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili reacts well to snuff out the attack.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+11' Juan Pulido has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+8' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

45+7' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Javi Guerra (Valencia), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
45+5' Luis Rioja (Valencia) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the middle of the goal. Karl Hein is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
45+5' The Valenciaplayers are livid after referee Juan Pulido signals NO GOAL after the VAR review!
45+4' Valencia score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
45+3' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Luis Rioja (Valencia) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
45+2' Karl Hein (Valladolid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45+2' Karl Hein (Valladolid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+1' Javi Guerra (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but Karl Hein comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
44' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Pulido no option but to blow his whistle. Valencia earn a free kick.
43' Luis Rioja (Valencia) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

42' Jose Gaya (Valencia) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out. Valencia have a corner.
40' 1 - 1 Goal! Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Giorgi Mamardashvili and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 1:1.

39' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
37' A decent cross gives Umar Sadiq (Valencia) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
37' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
35' Luis Perez (Valladolid) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
35' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
34' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

33' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.

32' Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Juan Pulido stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. That's a free kick to Valencia.

30' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
28' Jose Gaya (Valencia) commits a rough foul. Juan Pulido stops the game and makes a call. Valladolid win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
27' Raul Moro (Valladolid) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
27' Raul Moro (Valladolid) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Valladolid will take a corner.
26' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.
25' David Torres (Valladolid) looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Alvaro Rubio has decided that Cenk Ozkacar is the man to take his place.
23' David Torres (Valladolid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

22' Luis Rioja (Valencia) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
21' David Torres (Valladolid) is able to continue to play.
16' The game is interrupted. David Torres (Valladolid) suffers a horrific injury!
15' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
14' Raul Moro (Valladolid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
14' Jose Gaya (Valencia) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
13' Andre Almeida (Valencia) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
13' Andre Almeida (Valencia) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

11' Luis Rioja (Valencia) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.

9' Andre Almeida (Valencia) took a mid-range free kick and failed to find the target. The goalkeeper didn't need to react at all as his attempt went miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
8' Today's referee Juan Pulido rightly decides to book Florian Grillitsch (Valladolid) for his harsh tackle.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Diego Lopez (Valencia) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
6' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
5' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Diego Lopez (Valencia) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
3' Valencia are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
2' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
1' The first half has just begun.
Valladolid will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Juan Pulido.
